verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's domains page says domains stay locked against unauthorized transfers until the owner chooses to unlock them, which is a transfer lock by default. It also offers registry lock with custom out-of-band verification for ownership and nameserver changes on high-profile domains. Registry lock is limited to Enterprise customers, and both claims come only from marketing-page copy. Missing for 10: registry lock on non-Enterprise plans, in-depth developer docs on how lock and unlock work, independent or hands-on corroboration of either lock.
